newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX seen holding above 3,800 points.
newsitem.headline: German DAX seen holding above 3,800 points.

text.p: Germany's 30-share DAX index was expected to hold abov the psychologically important 3,800 point level in Monday trading after beginning slightly firmer in low volume trade.

Dealers said the positive effect of gains in other markets and the moderate rise in the U.S. dollar had helped market sentiment. A further gain in the dollar to above 1.74 marks would further buoy the market, they said.
The IBIS DAX index, based on computer trading, stood at 3,917.81 at 0747 GMT, up 7.89 points from Friday and about 20 points below an all-time high of 3,836.91 points.
Dealers said the outlook for the market would depend in part on the extent to which major fund houses had already finishhed squaring off their positions for the first half.

Further major market stimuli were not expected this week. The U.S. Federal Reserve's policy-making committee meeting would of course be watched, but with no interest rate move expected little market impact was seen likely.
Chemical and automotive stocks were expected to be the focus of trading during the day.
